text:
Lola: Lamp gave up mid-standup and then the sun came in at the worst angle. finished the meeting by propping my phone on a stack of notebooks for extra light. anyone have quick fixes for sudden window glare vs monitor? (no, I can't move the desk)
Alex: Oof. binder-clip monitor hood + angle tilt. looks ridiculous but actually works :thumbsup:
Sam: Polarizing screen protector from Amazon. cheap and cuts a lot of glare, especially during golden hour.
Maria: Lower the blinds like 10% and angle the slats. plants still get light but you avoid direct hit. also my monstera lives for it lol :heart_eyes:
Tanvi: DIY hack — cut a rectangle from a cereal box, wrap with black tape, clip to top of monitor. 2 mins, blocks top-right glare.
Lola: @Tanvi can you snap what that looks like? I'm allergic to craft projects but desperate :sweat_smile:
Tanvi: uploading photo... (pretend there's a pic) — here you go, it's literally cardboard + gaffer tape.
Jesse: tiny poll for the chaos: react with one of these: :sun_with_face: for natural light, :bulb: for getting a dedicated desk lamp, :card_index_dividers: for monitor hood/diffuser
Alex: :bulb:
Sam: :sun_with_face:
Maria: :sun_with_face:
Tanvi: :card_index_dividers:
Lola: Looks like I'll get a small adjustable lamp and a clip-on hood. also my little ficus survived the flashlight stand-up, so it's a win :seedling:
